visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic brokerage team pages: real broker names, Oregon licenses, transparent-PNG headshots, verbatim Google reviews, and a door to each /team/[slug] profile.
note: Look 2026-08-14: Team = faces. Order is Breadcrumb, AboutFaces (live broker cutouts reused from about/_v3, compact H1, name door, Call and Text on the face row from the live broker phone), Ledger (licenses, Matt-Rebecca-Paul rank), Quiet (verbatim reviews + FAQ + edges), Footer. PUBLIC_UI.md opens About-family on Quiet + Sheet. Faces first. The family's Sheet lives on /contact and /team/[slug]. Seller lives on Sell. The next tap is the name or the number. Reviews: getReviews(24) sorted so non-Matt-named reviews surface first (design-audit #156), TESTIMONIALS fallback when the live pool is empty. No invented quotes. KB-era deletions: KbHero, KbAbout, KbTeam, KbTestimonials, KbSell, FAQBlock, SmoothScrollProvider, KbFooter, kb-root, kb.css import.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > Team. Surface tone (this page opens on cream faces, not a dark Stage). Current page never a link.

requiredComponents.name: AboutFaces
requiredComponents.section: First viewport. Same AboutFaces row as /about. Live brokers from getBrokers, canonical /images/brokers/*.png cutouts. The first face fills the 390 fold. Name is the door to /team/[slug]. Call and text sit on that row from the live broker phone. No card, no wash, no rectangular box. Compact H1 lives here. No eyebrow, no card graf, no seller ask.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6, once, below the fold. Verbatim reviews (live pool or TESTIMONIALS), the same FAQ array the FAQPage JSON-LD uses, and outbound edges including Value my home. Seller does not open the page.

requiredComponents.name: V3Ledger
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 3, once, after the faces. One plain row per broker from getBrokers, ordered Matt, Rebecca, Paul. License in the detail line. Empty branch uses emptyMessage.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS. Rendered OUTSIDE <main> so the footer maps to role=contentinfo.

layoutComponents.name: PublicNav

deferredComponents.name: V3Sheet
deferredComponents.reason: About destinations open on Quiet + Sheet, but the capture forms already live on /contact and /team/[slug]. Adding a Sheet here would be a new capture contract.

deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 4 needs owned media and is never allowed over a number. V3Stage is one full-bleed frame with a navy scrim, which would put a rectangle behind the transparent broker PNGs. AboutFaces does that owned-media job on cream instead.

deferredComponents.name: V3Instrument
deferredComponents.reason: This page publishes people, not a market answer. Licenses sit on the Ledger rows.

deferredComponents.name: V3Field
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 2 is live inventory. It opens Homes.

perBrokerPage.note: Per-broker profile on the v3 barrel. Invariants: (1) reviewBelongsOnPage filters every review. (2) getBrokerSales provides per-broker closings (both sides); fallback is getBrokerageListingTiles. (3) JSON-LD RealEstateAgent + BreadcrumbList preserved. (4) 977 zip filter on closings. (5) photo-only ledger tiles. (6) BrokerValuationSheet posts the same submitBrokerSellerLead object (variant seller, fields address / name / email / phone / timeline / notes). (7) SmsConsentDisclosure renders because the sheet collects a phone; the action does not read smsConsent. (8) Direct call/text/email from live phone/email only. (9) First viewport is AboutFaces, same cutout as /about and /team.
